title: The Glasshouse of the reservoir
author: Ivo Okafor
blurb: Jonah Montrose, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
